topic: Standardizing task management and data access
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on standardizing internal processes, specifically regarding task tracking and system access. Participants agreed that all tasks should be managed within a single system (Jira) to avoid fragmentation across multiple channels/tools.

Regarding data access, one participant requested write access to postgres/clickhouse. Another participant noted the complexity of existing communication channels (e.g., Issues, Brazil Dev, IT channel), reinforcing the need for centralized task management.
decisions: All tasks must be logged and managed within Jira.
action_items: Review and standardize data deletion procedures (mentioned by p3).
Determine a time to meet with [p4].
